excerpt: Remote GitHub MCP recommends OAuth. Dynamic Client Registration is not supported. Register a GitHub App or OAuth App; client secrets belong in the host application backend.

Confidential OAuth. Registered internal or Marketplace app. User-token authorization endpoint https://slack.com/oauth/v2_user/authorize; token endpoint https://slack.com/api/oauth.v2.user.access. No DCR.
Documented user-only token response uses top-level access_token, token_type user, and authed_user.scope. Supports code_verifier and refresh_token. JD normalises this token type only for Slack.
Remote MCP URL https://mcp.notion.com/mcp; complete provider OAuth to connect. Not an integration-token substitute.
